author: tedcruz
text:
Mao’s record:

— ~30 million dead in the Great Leap Forward famine
— At least 2.5 million beaten or tortured to death
— ~720,000 executed in the Campaign to Suppress Counterrevolutionaries
— 1.1–1.6 million dead in the Cultural Revolution
— Tens of millions subjected to political persecution  

Hasan Piker: “One of the great leaders of this world.”
